deliverables: Full-stack open-source payments infrastructure for Cardano
Connections to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces
Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, wallet layer, and API ecosystem layer
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with project funding later transferred to a Project-Specific Smart Contract for Wirex when legal contract and vendor readiness conditions are met.
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex.

claims.claim: Wirex says the proposal addresses Cardano's lack of integrated infrastructure for everyday spending, merchant acceptance, and fiat-connected financial activity at scale.

The proposal states it will deliver full-stack open-source payments infrastructure enabling onchain settlement through smart contracts and connectivity to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
The proposal states a core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
The proposal states Wirex has 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.

The proposal says the work aligns with Pillar 1 by providing public-good on-chain infrastructure including smart contracts, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet and API ecosystem components.

The proposal says it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting materials, documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.

The proposal states the requested amount does not, at submission, individually or in aggregate breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 and links to the relevant governance action.
The budget allocates 3,846,153 ADA to Enabling Onchain Payments and Card Infrastructure and 115,385 ADA to the Intersect Budget Administration fee, totaling 3,961,538 ADA.
The proposal states Wirex has not received ADA from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

The proposal describes treasury management controls using Intersect-administered Sundae Labs smart contracts, external oversight entities, multisignature authorization thresholds, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard with on-chain auditability.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ADA for Wirex-related real-world payment infrastructure, with funds routed through Intersect treasury management smart contracts and described oversight controls. The proposal provides a budget split, governance process references, NCL compliance assertions, and smart contract addresses, while several adoption and execution-capability claims about Wirex and market impact are asserted without evidence inside the document.
